journey.name: Shake Detection (Emulator, injected sensor)
journey.description: End-to-end shake detection on an emulator, driving the virtual accelerometer with "adb emu sensor set acceleration x:y:z" instead of physical shaking. Magnitude thresholds: SMALL > 11 m/s^2, BIG > 16 m/s^2, hold 1s.

actions.action: Verify that the app shows "Shake your phone!" and an "Acceleration:" reading near 9.8 (virtual device at rest)
Set the virtual accelerometer to magnitude ~13 m/s^2 and verify that the label changes to "Small Shake Detected!"
Set the virtual accelerometer to magnitude ~20 m/s^2 and verify that the label changes to "Big Shake Detected!"
Reset the virtual accelerometer to rest (~9.8 m/s^2), wait over 1 second, and verify that the label returns to "Shake your phone!"
